Class EquinixRequest<T>

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.http.request.EquinixRequest<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
PaginatedPostRequest, PaginatedRequest
public class EquinixRequest<T> extends Object
Base request type for all Equinix API calls. Concrete and directly instantiable for the simple GET/single/list cases; PaginatedRequest and PaginatedPostRequest extend it to add offset/limit paging and POST-search paging respectively.

The request body — when the operation has one — is carried as a single RequestBody (JSON payload, form fields, or raw bytes); the wire entity is built from it by RequestFactory at dispatch time. No transport (Apache HttpClient) type appears in this class's API.

The type parameter T threads the operation's model type from request construction through EquinixResponse handling; it carries no state on the request itself.

Author:
ianjones

  • Method Details

    • setQueryParameters

      public void setQueryParameters(Map<String, List<String>> queryParameters)
      Sets the query parameters, defensively deep-copying into a mutable map with mutable value lists. Callers frequently pass immutable maps and lists (Map.of("category", List.of("COLO"))); pagination later mutates the map (adding offset/limit) and addQueryParameter/addSingleQueryParameter append to the value lists, so storing the caller's instances directly would throw UnsupportedOperationException (and alias the caller's collections). This override (in place of Lombok's generated setter) guarantees both levels are always mutable and unaliased.
      Parameters:
      queryParameters - the query parameters (may be null or immutable)
